hook: Ek database pe [[bojh]]? Data baanto [[sharding]] se

slides.title: Sharding = Data ke [[tukde]]
points: Badi table ko **alag servers** par baanto
Har server pe **chhota data**, fast query
Swiggy jaise apps ke **crore users** ke liye
slides.note: Bole toh: Ek bade restaurant mein ek hi waiter ke bajaye **alag tables pe alag waiters** rakhna

slides.title: Kyun zaroori hai [[bhai]]?
points: Single machine ki **RAM/Disk** full ho gayi
slides.note: Facebook ya Instagram ka data **ek hard drive** mein aa hi nahi sakta 🤯

slides.title: Partitioning vs [[Sharding]]
slides.note: Partitioning ek ghar ke alag kamre hain, Sharding **alag-alag shehron mein ghar** hain

slides.title: Shard Key kaise [[chunein]]?
slides.code:
-- Example: Range Sharding by ID
-- Server 1: user_id 1 to 10000
-- Server 2: user_id 10001 to 20000

SELECT * FROM users 
WHERE user_id = 15050; -- Server 2 pe jaayega
slides.note: Galat Shard Key chuni toh **saare servers pe query chalani padegi** (Scatter-Gather)

slides.title: Sharding ke [[tareeqe]]
points: **Range Based**: ID ke hisaab se (A-M, N-Z)
**Directory Based**: Look-up table bataegi kahan hai
slides.note: Hash sharding se **data evenly baant** jaata hai, koi ek server overload nahi hota

slides.title: Hash Sharding ka [[funda]]
slides.note: Har user ka ID hash hoke decide karta hai ki **kaunse server pe save** hoga

slides.wrong: Sharding **shuru se hi** laga lo har chote project par, future-proof banega
slides.right: Sharding sirf **tab lagao** jab single DB handle na kar paaye
slides.why: Complexities badh jaati hain (JOINs mushkil, transactions slow). Premature sharding = headache 💀

points: **Shard Key** dhyan se chunni padti hai
Complexity laata hai, **jab zaroorat ho tabhi** use karo
